mapper.select: /*master.mdam.selectMasterMdAmProxyHomeList*/ SELECT MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER)) AS BUYER_NM , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(A.YYYY, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY'),A.SALES_AMT, 0))/1000,0) AS TTL_SALE_WAREHOUSING , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(A.YYYY, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY'),A.MARGIN_AMT, 0))/1000,0) AS TTL_SALE_MARGIN_WAREHOUSING , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(A.YYYYMM, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE , -1),'YYYYMM'),A.SALES_AMT, 0))/1000,0) AS LM_SALE_WAREHOUSING , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(A.YYYYMM, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE , -1),'YYYYMM'),A.MARGIN_AMT, 0))/1000,0) AS LM_SALE_MARGIN_WAREHOUSING , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(A.YYYYMM, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMM'),A.SALES_AMT, 0))/1000,0) AS M_SALE_WAREHOUSING , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(A.YYYYMM, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMM'),A.MARGIN_AMT, 0))/1000,0) AS M_SALE_MARGIN_WAREHOUSING FROM BNTMIS_CUST A WHERE YYYY IN(TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE , -1),'YYYY'),TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY')) AND A.BUYER IN ( SELECT MNG.BUYER FROM ICOMCOD3 COD3, MIS_BUYER_MNG MNG WHERE COD3.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD3.TYPE = 'CMPY' AND COD3.CODE1= MNG.KEP_DEPT AND COD3.CODE2 = #{user_id} AND MNG.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND MNG.STATUS = 'C' UNION SELECT BUYER FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG B WHERE B.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND B.STATUS = 'C' AND B.KEP_USER_ID = #{user_id}) GROUP BY A.BUYER ORDER BY 1

/*master.mdam.selectMasterMdAmProxyMainWorkProcessSumList*/ SELECT SUM(IV_DO_NO_CNT) AS IV_DO_NO_CNT , SUM(IV_LONG_DO_NO_CNT) AS IV_LONG_DO_NO_CNT , SUM(IV_EXPECT_DELAY_CNT) AS IV_EXPECT_DELAY_CNT , SUM(IV_DELAY_CNT) AS IV_DELAY_CNT , SUM(IV_LONG_EXPECT_DELAY_CNT) AS IV_LONG_EXPECT_DELAY_CNT , SUM(IV_DI_NO_CNT) AS IV_DI_NO_CNT , SUM(QT_RECV_CNT) AS QT_RECV_CNT , SUM(QT_DELAY_CNT) AS QT_DELAY_CNT , SUM(QT_LONG_DELAY_CNT) AS QT_LONG_DELAY_CNT , SUM(IV_BAD_DELAY_CNT) AS IV_BAD_DELAY_CNT , SUM(IF_ERR_CNT) AS IF_ERR_CNT , SUM(IF_STOP_CNT) AS IF_STOP_CNT , SUM(GR_NO_CNT) AS GR_NO_CNT , SUM(NW_ITM_SPEC_REQ_CNT) AS NW_ITM_SPEC_REQ_CNT , SUM(NW_ITM_SPEC_CHK_CNT) AS NW_ITM_SPEC_CHK_CNT , SUM(QT_NEGO_REQ_CNT) AS QT_NEGO_REQ_CNT FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT(SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME_LOC -- 0 구매사 , NVL(B.IV_DO_NO_CNT,0) AS IV_DO_NO_CNT -- 1 수주접수_미접수건 , NVL(B.IV_LONG_DO_NO_CNT,0) AS IV_LONG_DO_NO_CNT -- 2 수주접수_장기미접수건 , NVL(B.IV_EXPECT_DELAY_CNT,0) AS IV_EXPECT_DELAY_CNT -- 3 납기_지연예상건 , NVL(B.IV_DELAY_CNT,0) AS IV_DELAY_CNT -- 4 납기_지연건 , NVL(B.IV_LONG_EXPECT_DELAY_CNT,0) AS IV_LONG_EXPECT_DELAY_CNT -- 5 납기_장기지연건 , NVL(B.IV_DI_NO_CNT,0) AS IV_DI_NO_CNT -- 6 납기_실적미등록건 , NVL((SELECT SUM(QT_RECV_CNT) FROM KEP_PM_PA_MNG WHERE BUYER = B.BUYER),0) AS QT_RECV_CNT -- 7 견적_의뢰건 --KEPRQDT.ITEM_GROUP = NULL 이면 취합시 'M'으로 카운트, (OPA팀 확인불가), 해서 M+O한 수량을 사업팀 OPA팀 표시. , NVL(B.QT_DELAY_CNT,0) AS QT_DELAY_CNT -- 8 견적_제출지연건 , NVL(B.QT_LONG_DELAY_CNT,0) AS QT_LONG_DELAY_CNT -- 9 견적_장기지연건 , A.BUYER AS BUYER -- 10 , NVL(B.IV_BAD_DELAY_CNT,0) AS IV_BAD_DELAY_CNT -- 11 납기_악성지연건 , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IF_PROGRESS C WHERE C.BUYER =A.BUYER AND C.IF_FLAG IN ('A','N') AND C.GUBUN = 'PO') AS IF_ERR_CNT -- 12 I/F오류 , ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT X.PR_NO||Y.LEGACY_PO_NO||X.BUYER) FROM ICOMPRHD X, ICOMPRDT Y WHERE X.RECV_FLAG = 'AT' AND X.PR_NO = Y.PR_NO AND X.BUYER = Y.BUYER AND X.BUYER = A.BUYER AND X.SAVE_FLAG = 'PX' AND X.STATUS != 'D' AND Y.STATUS != 'D') AS IF_STOP_CNT -- I/F 임시저장 , ( SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID=A.KEP_USER_ID) AS KEP_USER_NAME -- 13 , NVL(B.GR_NO_CNT,0) AS GR_NO_CNT -- 14 납기_미입고건 , A.ITEM_GROUP AS ITEM_GROUP , NVL(B.NW_ITM_SPEC_REQ_CNT,0) AS NW_ITM_SPEC_REQ_CNT -- 품목정비 , NVL(B.NW_ITM_SPEC_CHK_CNT,0) AS NW_ITM_SPEC_CHK_CNT -- 물질정보 , NVL(B.QT_NEGO_REQ_CNT,0) AS QT_NEGO_REQ_CNT -- Nego의뢰건 FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG A, KEP_PM_PA_MNG B WHERE A.YEAR=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND A.KEP_USER_ID = #{user_id} AND A.STATUS ='C' AND 'M'=B.ITEM_GROUP AND A.BUYER=B.BUYER(+) ORDER BY 1 ) X

/*master.mdam.selectMasterMdAmProxyDocTypeFPoList*/ SELECT (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=X.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME , X.BUYER , NVL(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMPOHD A, ICOMPODT B WHERE A.BUYER=X.BUYER AND A.DOC_TYPE ^='X' AND A.PO_CREATE_DATE>=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-30, 'YYYYMMDD') AND A.STATUS ^='D' AND A.DOC_TYPE='F' AND A.BUYER=B.BUYER AND A.PO_NO=B.PO_NO AND B.STATUS ^='D' AND B.ITEM_QTY>B.GR_QTY AND B.ITEM_QTY>B.DI_QTY GROUP BY B.BUYER),0) AS GINGEUB_CNT -- 긴급납기 , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_MNG WHERE BUYER=X.BUYER AND STATUS='C') AS BS_REG_CNT -- 선입고_선입고요청 , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_MNG WHERE BUYER=X.BUYER AND STATUS='F') AS BS_FINISH_CNT -- 선입고_발주완료 , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_MNG WHERE BUYER=X.BUYER AND STATUS='P') AS BS_PARTIAL_CNT -- 선입고_부분완료 , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_MNG WHERE BUYER=X.BUYER AND STATUS='D') AS BS_CANCEL_CNT -- 선입고_선입고취소 FROM BUYEROWN X WHERE X.USER_ID = #{user_id}

/*master.mdam.selectMasterMdAmProxyMainWorkProcessDLList*/ WITH TOT_PMPA_CNT AS ( SELECT B.KEP_DEPT AS KEP_DEPT, A.GUBUN, COUNT(DISTINCT A.BUYER||A.KEY1||A.KEY2||A.KEY3||A.KEY4) AS CNT FROM KEP_PM_PA_LIST A, MIS_BUYER_MNG B WHERE A.BUYER=B.BUYER AND B.YEAR=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND B.STATUS='C' AND B.PRIORITY = 'Y' GROUP BY B.KEP_DEPT, A.GUBUN ORDER BY 2 ) SELECT C.TEXT2 AS DEPT_NAME, NVL((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT A.BUYER||A.LEGACY_NO) AS IF_ERR_CNT FROM IF_PROGRESS A, MIS_BUYER_MNG B WHERE A.IF_FLAG IN ('A','N') AND A.GUBUN='PO' AND A.BUYER=B.BUYER AND B.YEAR=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND B.STATUS='C' AND B.KEP_DEPT=C.CODE GROUP BY B.KEP_DEPT ),0) AS IF_ERR_CNT, NVL((SELECT NVL(CNT,0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_DEPT=C.CODE AND GUBUN='IV_DO_NO'),0) AS IV_DO_NO_CNT, NVL((SELECT NVL(CNT,0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_DEPT=C.CODE AND GUBUN='IV_LONG_DO_NO'),0) AS IV_LONG_DO_NO_CNT, NVL((SELECT NVL(CNT,0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_DEPT=C.CODE AND GUBUN='IV_EXPECT_DELAY'),0) AS IV_EXPECT_DELAY_CNT, NVL((SELECT NVL(CNT,0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_DEPT=C.CODE AND GUBUN='IV_DELAY'),0) AS IV_DELAY_CNT, NVL((SELECT NVL(CNT,0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_DEPT=C.CODE AND GUBUN='IV_LONG_EXPECT_DELAY'),0) AS IV_LONG_EXPECT_DELAY_CNT, NVL((SELECT NVL(CNT,0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_DEPT=C.CODE AND GUBUN='IV_BAD_DELAY'),0) AS IV_BAD_DELAY_CNT, NVL((SELECT NVL(CNT,0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_DEPT=C.CODE AND GUBUN='IV_DI_NO'),0) AS IV_DI_NO_CNT, NVL((SELECT NVL(CNT,0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_DEPT=C.CODE AND GUBUN='QT_RECV'),0) AS QT_RECV_CNT, NVL((SELECT NVL(CNT,0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_DEPT=C.CODE AND GUBUN='QT_DELAY'),0) AS QT_DELAY_CNT, NVL((SELECT NVL(CNT,0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_DEPT=C.CODE AND GUBUN='QT_LONG_DELAY'),0) AS QT_LONG_DELAY_CNT, NVL((SELECT NVL(CNT,0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_DEPT=C.CODE AND GUBUN='GR_NOT'),0) AS GR_NO_DELAY, C.CODE FROM ICOMCOD2 C WHERE C.COMPANY_CODE='KRKORE0001' AND C.TEXT3 = 'ARAP' AND C.TYPE='C001' AND C.FLAG='Y' ORDER BY 1

/*master.mdam.selectMasterMdAmProxyMainWorkProcessTLList*/ SELECT (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=B.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME_LOC, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IF_PROGRESS C WHERE C.BUYER =B.BUYER AND C.IF_FLAG IN ('A','N') AND C.GUBUN = 'PO' ) AS IF_ERR_CNT, MAX(B.IV_DO_NO_CNT) AS IV_DO_NO_CNT, MAX(B.IV_LONG_DO_NO_CNT) AS IV_LONG_DO_NO_CNT, MAX(B.IV_EXPECT_DELAY_CNT) AS IV_EXPECT_DELAY_CNT, MAX(B.IV_DELAY_CNT) AS IV_DELAY_CNT, MAX(B.IV_LONG_EXPECT_DELAY_CNT) AS IV_LONG_EXPECT_DELAY_CNT, MAX(B.IV_BAD_DELAY_CNT) AS IV_BAD_DELAY_CNT, MAX(B.IV_DI_NO_CNT) AS IV_DI_NO_CNT, SUM(distinct NVL(B.GR_NO_CNT,0)) AS GR_NO_CNT, MAX(B.QT_RECV_CNT) AS QT_RECV_CNT, MAX(B.QT_DELAY_CNT) AS QT_DELAY_CNT, MAX(B.QT_LONG_DELAY_CNT) AS QT_LONG_DELAY_CNT, B.BUYER, MAX((SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID=A.KEP_USER_ID)) AS KEP_USER_NAME, B.ITEM_GROUP FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG A, KEP_PM_PA_MNG B WHERE A.YEAR=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYY') AND A.STATUS='C' AND A.ITEM_GROUP=B.ITEM_GROUP AND A.KEP_DEPT = #{dept_code} AND A.BUYER=B.BUYER GROUP BY B.BUYER, B.ITEM_GROUP

/*master.mdam.selectMasterMdAmProxyMainWorkProcessBLList*/ WITH TOT_PMPA_CNT AS ( SELECT B.KEP_DEPT AS KEP_DEPT, A.GUBUN, A.KEY4, B.POSITION_GROUP, COUNT(DISTINCT A.BUYER||A.KEY1||A.KEY2||A.KEY3||A.KEY4) AS CNT FROM KEP_PM_PA_LIST A, MIS_BUYER_MNG B WHERE A.BUYER=B.BUYER AND A.KEY4=B.ITEM_GROUP AND B.YEAR=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND B.STATUS='C' AND B.KEP_DEPT IN (${param1}) GROUP BY B.KEP_DEPT, A.GUBUN, A.KEY4, B.POSITION_GROUP ORDER BY 2 ) SELECT C.TEXT2 AS DEPT_NAME, NVL((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT A.BUYER||A.LEGACY_NO) AS IF_ERR_CNT FROM IF_PROGRESS A, MIS_BUYER_MNG B WHERE A.IF_FLAG IN ('A','N') AND A.GUBUN='PO' AND A.BUYER=B.BUYER AND B.YEAR=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND B.STATUS='C' AND B.KEP_DEPT=C.CODE AND B.ITEM_GROUP = DECODE(B.KEP_DEPT,'017','O','M') GROUP BY B.KEP_DEPT ),0) AS IF_ERR_CNT, NVL((SELECT NVL(CNT,0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_DEPT=C.CODE AND GUBUN='IV_DO_NO' AND POSITION_GROUP='PA' AND KEY4 = DECODE(C.CODE,'017','O','M')),0) AS IV_DO_NO_CNT, NVL((SELECT NVL(CNT,0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_DEPT=C.CODE AND GUBUN='IV_LONG_DO_NO' AND POSITION_GROUP='PM' AND KEY4 = DECODE(C.CODE,'017','O','M')),0) AS IV_LONG_DO_NO_CNT, NVL((SELECT NVL(CNT,0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_DEPT=C.CODE AND GUBUN='IV_EXPECT_DELAY' AND POSITION_GROUP='PA' AND KEY4 = DECODE(C.CODE,'017','O','M')),0) AS IV_EXPECT_DELAY_CNT, NVL((SELECT NVL(CNT,0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_DEPT=C.CODE AND GUBUN='IV_DELAY' AND POSITION_GROUP='PA' AND KEY4 = DECODE(C.CODE,'017','O','M')),0) AS IV_DELAY_CNT, NVL((SELECT NVL(CNT,0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_DEPT=C.CODE AND GUBUN='IV_LONG_EXPECT_DELAY' AND POSITION_GROUP='PM' AND KEY4 = DECODE(C.CODE,'017','O','M')),0) AS IV_LONG_EXPECT_DELAY_CNT, NVL((SELECT NVL(CNT,0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_DEPT=C.CODE AND GUBUN='IV_BAD_DELAY' AND POSITION_GROUP='PA' AND KEY4 = DECODE(C.CODE,'017','O','M')),0) AS IV_BAD_DELAY_CNT, NVL((SELECT NVL(CNT,0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_DEPT=C.CODE AND GUBUN='IV_DI_NO' AND POSITION_GROUP='PA' AND KEY4 = DECODE(C.CODE,'017','O','M')),0) AS IV_DI_NO_CNT, NVL((SELECT NVL(CNT,0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_DEPT=C.CODE AND GUBUN='QT_RECV' AND POSITION_GROUP='PA' AND KEY4 = DECODE(C.CODE,'017','O','M')),0) AS QT_RECV_CNT, NVL((SELECT NVL(CNT,0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_DEPT=C.CODE AND GUBUN='QT_DELAY' AND POSITION_GROUP='PA' AND KEY4 = DECODE(C.CODE,'017','O','M')),0) AS QT_DELAY_CNT, NVL((SELECT NVL(CNT,0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_DEPT=C.CODE AND GUBUN='QT_LONG_DELAY' AND POSITION_GROUP='PA' AND KEY4 = DECODE(C.CODE,'017','O','M')),0) AS QT_LONG_DELAY_CNT, NVL((SELECT NVL(CNT,0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_DEPT=C.CODE AND GUBUN='GR_NOT' AND POSITION_GROUP='PA' AND KEY4 = DECODE(C.CODE,'017','O','M')),0) AS GR_NO_DELAY, C.CODE FROM ICOMCOD2 C WHERE C.COMPANY_CODE='KRKORE0001' AND C.CODE IN (${param1}) AND C.TYPE='C001' AND C.FLAG='Y' ORDER BY 1

/*master.mdam.selectWorkProcessListByUser*/ WITH TOT_PMPA_CNT AS ( SELECT A.BUYER, B.KEP_USER_ID, A.GUBUN, B.POSITION_GROUP, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM KEP_PM_PA_LIST A, MIS_BUYER_MNG B WHERE A.BUYER=B.BUYER AND A.KEY4=B.ITEM_GROUP AND B.YEAR=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND B.STATUS='C' GROUP BY A.BUYER, B.KEP_USER_ID, A.GUBUN, B.POSITION_GROUP ) SELECT MAX(X.KEP_USER_NAME) AS KEP_USER_NAME, SUM(X.IF_ERR_CNT) AS IF_ERR_CNT, SUM(X.IV_DO_NO) AS IV_DO_NO_CNT, SUM(X.IV_LONG_DO_NO) AS IV_LONG_DO_NO_CNT, SUM(X.IV_EXPECT_DELAY) AS IV_EXPECT_DELAY_CNT, SUM(X.IV_DELAY) AS IV_DELAY_CNT, SUM(X.IV_LONG_EXPECT_DELAY) AS IV_LONG_EXPECT_DELAY_CNT, SUM(X.IV_DI_NO) AS IV_DI_NO_CNT, SUM(X.QT_RECV) AS QT_RECV_CNT, SUM(X.QT_DELAY) AS QT_DELAY_CNT, SUM(X.QT_LONG_DELAY) AS QT_LONG_DELAY_CNT, SUM(X.IV_BAD_DELAY) AS IV_BAD_DELAY_CNT, SUM(X.GR_NO_DELAY) AS GR_NO_DELAY_CNT FROM( SELECT (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID=A.KEP_USER_ID) AS KEP_USER_NAME, 0 AS IF_ERR_CNT, (SELECT NVL(SUM(CNT),0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_USER_ID=A.KEP_USER_ID AND GUBUN='IV_DO_NO' AND POSITION_GROUP='PA') AS IV_DO_NO, (SELECT NVL(SUM(CNT),0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_USER_ID=A.KEP_USER_ID AND GUBUN='IV_LONG_DO_NO' AND POSITION_GROUP='PM') AS IV_LONG_DO_NO, (SELECT NVL(SUM(CNT),0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_USER_ID=A.KEP_USER_ID AND GUBUN='IV_EXPECT_DELAY' AND POSITION_GROUP='PA') AS IV_EXPECT_DELAY, (SELECT NVL(SUM(CNT),0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_USER_ID=A.KEP_USER_ID AND GUBUN='IV_DELAY' AND POSITION_GROUP='PA') AS IV_DELAY, (SELECT NVL(SUM(CNT),0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_USER_ID=A.KEP_USER_ID AND GUBUN='IV_LONG_EXPECT_DELAY' AND POSITION_GROUP='PM') AS IV_LONG_EXPECT_DELAY, (SELECT NVL(SUM(CNT),0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_USER_ID=A.KEP_USER_ID AND GUBUN='IV_DI_NO' AND POSITION_GROUP='PA') AS IV_DI_NO, (SELECT NVL(SUM(CNT),0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_USER_ID=A.KEP_USER_ID AND GUBUN='QT_RECV' AND POSITION_GROUP='PA') AS QT_RECV, (SELECT NVL(SUM(CNT),0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_USER_ID=A.KEP_USER_ID AND GUBUN='QT_DELAY' AND POSITION_GROUP='PA') AS QT_DELAY, (SELECT NVL(SUM(CNT),0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_USER_ID=A.KEP_USER_ID AND GUBUN='QT_LONG_DELAY' AND POSITION_GROUP='PA') AS QT_LONG_DELAY, (SELECT NVL(SUM(CNT),0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_USER_ID=A.KEP_USER_ID AND GUBUN='IV_BAD_DELAY' AND POSITION_GROUP='BM') AS IV_BAD_DELAY, (SELECT NVL(SUM(CNT),0) FROM TOT_PMPA_CNT WHERE KEP_USER_ID=A.KEP_USER_ID AND GUBUN='GR_NO_DELAY' AND POSITION_GROUP='PA') AS GR_NO_DELAY, A.KEP_USER_ID FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG A WHERE A.YEAR=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND A.STATUS='C' AND A.KEP_DEPT = #{dept_code} GROUP BY A.KEP_USER_ID, A.ITEM_GROUP UNION SELECT (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID=B.KEP_USER_ID) AS KEP_USER_NAME, COUNT(*) AS IF_ERR_CNT, 0 AS IV_DO_NO, 0 AS IV_LONG_DO_NO, 0 AS IV_EXPECT_DELAY, 0 AS IV_DELAY, 0 AS IV_LONG_EXPECT_DELAY, 0 AS IV_DI_NO, 0 AS QT_RECV, 0 AS QT_DELAY, 0 AS QT_LONG_DELAY, 0 AS IV_BAD_DELAY, 0 AS GR_NO_DELAY, B.KEP_USER_ID FROM IF_PROGRESS A, MIS_BUYER_MNG B WHERE A.IF_FLAG IN ('A','N') AND A.GUBUN='PO' AND A.BUYER=B.BUYER AND B.YEAR=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND B.STATUS='C' AND B.KEP_DEPT = #{dept_code} AND B.POSITION_GROUP='PA' GROUP BY B.KEP_USER_ID,B.ITEM_GROUP) X GROUP BY KEP_USER_ID

/*master.mdam.selectMasterMdAmProxyMainWorkProcessSSList*/ SELECT (SELECT COD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE ='USRTYPE' AND COD.CODE = 'SS' /**P*/ AND COD.FLAG ='Y') AS DEPT , MAX(X.TOT_3_TARGET) AS TOT_3_TARGET , MAX(X.TOT_TARGET) , MAX(X.TOT_COMP) , DECODE(MAX(X.TOT_COMP),0,0,ROUND(MAX(X.TOT_TARGET) / MAX(X.TOT_COMP)*100,2)) AS TOT_RATE FROM ( SELECT '1' GBN ,COUNT(BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS TOT_3_TARGET , 0 AS TOT_TARGET , 0 AS TOT_COMP FROM KEPRQDT A WHERE A.SG_D_DATE IS NULL AND A.BTOA_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.RECV_FLAG IN ('NW', 'GA') AND A.BTOA_NEGO_PRICE = 0 AND A.KEP_USER_ID IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE ='EXCCMPY' AND COD.CODE = A.BUYER AND NVL(COD.TEXT4, 'N') != 'Y' )
UNION ALL SELECT '1' GBN ,0 AS TOT_3_TARGET , COUNT(A.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS TOT_TARGET , 0 AS TOT_COMP FROM KEPRQDT A WHERE A.SG_D_DATE IS NOT NULL AND A.BTOA_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND A.RECV_FLAG != 'GD' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE ='EXCCMPY' AND COD.CODE = A.BUYER AND NVL(COD.TEXT4, 'N') != 'Y' ) UNION ALL SELECT '1' GBN , 0 AS TOT_3_TARGET , 0 AS TOT_TARGET , COUNT(A.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS TOT_COMP FROM KEPRQDT A WHERE A.BTOA_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND A.RECV_FLAG != 'GD' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE ='EXCCMPY' AND COD.CODE = A.BUYER AND NVL(COD.TEXT4, 'N') != 'Y' ) ) X GROUP BY GBN

/*master.mdam.selectMasterMdAmProxyMainWorkProcessSMList*/ SELECT A.USER_DEPT ,(SELECT COD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 COD WHERE COD.TYPE ='C001' AND COD.COMPANY_CODE ='KRKORE0001' AND COD.CODE = A.USER_DEPT) AS USER_DEPT_NM ,A.USER_ID ,(SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = A.USER_ID) AS USR_NM ,A.T_ITEM_CNT ,A.EXPIRED_ITEM_CNT ,A.MON_01 ,A.MON_02 ,A.MON_03 ,A.MON_04 ,A.MON_05 ,A.MON_06 ,A.MON_07 ,A.MON_08 ,A.MON_09 ,A.MON_10 ,A.MON_11 ,A.MON_12 ,A.UNPROCESSED_VOC_CNT FROM KEP_SM_BOARD A WHERE A.USER_DEPT = DECODE(#{user_type},'SOF',A.USER_DEPT,#{dept_code}) ORDER BY 2, 4

/*master.mdam.selectMasterMdAmProxyMainWorkProcessDSMList*/ SELECT XX.USER_DEPT ,(SELECT COD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 COD WHERE COD.TYPE ='C001' AND COD.COMPANY_CODE ='KRKORE0001' AND COD.CODE = XX.USER_DEPT) AS USER_DEPT_NM ,XX.USER_ID ,(SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = XX.USER_ID) AS USR_NM ,XX.SOURCING_CM_CNT ,XX.SOURCING_CM_1DAY ,XX.SOURCING_CM_2DAY ,XX.SOURCING_CM_3_4DAY ,XX.SOURCING_CM_5DAY_OVER ,XX.UNPROCESSED_VOC_CNT FROM KEP.KEP_DSM_BOARD XX WHERE XX.USER_DEPT = DECODE(#{user_type},'SOF',XX.USER_DEPT,REPLACE(#{dept_code},'_A','')) ORDER BY 2, 4
